premise: A big turtle crawls slowly up the beach; Sandpiper has never seen her, but she was born right here long ago and has come back across the whole sea.
inspiration: The Odyssey's long homecoming made tiny and gentle: the traveller comes home not to fight but to say hello to the sand where she began.
lesson: Home stays with you, however far you go.
learning: Sea turtles come back to the beach where they hatched.

en-US.title: Turtle Comes Back
en-US.text: [slowly] Slowly, slowly, {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Turtle came crawling up the sand. {sfx:shuffle} Flip… flop… flip… {sandpiper:enter by run} {sandpiper:go to turtle by run} Sandpiper came running to see. {sandpiper:face surprised} [curious] Who are you? I've never seen you before! {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live talk} [warmly] Ah, but I've been here before, said Turtle. Long, long ago, I hatched right here, a teeny-tiny turtle in the warm sand. {sandpiper:wobble} Then I crawled down to the water and swam away. All the way across the wide sea… and back again. {turtle:glow 0.4} [in awe] Turtles always come home, she said, to the beach where they were born. {sandpiper:live peck} Sandpiper pecked at the ground, as if he might find the very spot. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish waved hello from the pool, {starfish:live wave} as excited as can be. {turtle:live peek} Turtle tucked her head in, shy for a moment, then peeked out with a smile. Welcome home, said Sandpiper. {turtle:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Then Turtle turned round {turtle:go to sea by swim} and swam off, far away. {sandpiper:live wave} Until next time.

es-ES.title: Tortuga vuelve a casa
es-ES.text: [slowly] Despacito, despacito, {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tortuga subió arrastrándose por la arena. {sfx:shuffle} Flip… flop… flip… {sandpiper:enter by run} {sandpiper:go to turtle by run} Correlimos vino corriendo a mirar. {sandpiper:face surprised} [curious] ¿Quién eres? ¡Nunca te había visto! {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live talk} [warmly] Ah, pero yo ya he estado aquí, dijo Tortuga. Hace muchísimo tiempo nací justo aquí, una tortuguita diminuta en la arena calentita. {sandpiper:wobble} Luego bajé hasta el agua y me fui nadando. Crucé todo el ancho mar… y he vuelto. {turtle:glow 0.4} [in awe] Las tortugas siempre vuelven, dijo, a la playa donde nacieron. {sandpiper:live peck} Correlimos picoteó el suelo, como si pudiera encontrar el sitio exacto. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella saludaba desde la charca, {starfish:live wave} emocionadísima. {turtle:live peek} Tortuga escondió la cabeza, un poco tímida, y luego asomó con una sonrisa. Bienvenida a casa, dijo Correlimos. {turtle:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Después, Tortuga se dio la vuelta {turtle:go to sea by swim} y se alejó nadando, muy lejos. {sandpiper:live wave} Hasta la próxima.

ja-JP.title: ウミガメさんの かえるところ
ja-JP.text: [slowly]ゆっくり、ゆっくり、{turtle:enter}{turtle:go to sand}ウミガメさんが、砂浜をはいあがってきました。{sfx:shuffle}ずりっ…ずりっ…ずりっ…{sandpiper:enter by run}{sandpiper:go to turtle by run}シギくんが、かけてきました。{sandpiper:face surprised}[curious]「だあれ？見たことないなあ！」 {turtle:face happy}{turtle:live talk}[warmly]「あら、わたしは、ここにきたことがあるのよ」 とウミガメさん。「ずうっとむかし、ここでうまれたの。あったかい砂のなかの、ちっちゃな、ちっちゃなあかちゃんだったのよ」 {sandpiper:wobble}「それから、水のほうへはっていって、およいでいったの。ひろーい海をわたって…また、もどってきたのよ」 {turtle:glow 0.4}[in awe]「ウミガメはね、うまれたうみべに、かならずかえってくるの」 {sandpiper:live peck}シギくんは、あしもとを、つんつん。そのばしょが、見つかるかもしれないから。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}潮だまりから、ヒトデさんが、{starfish:live wave}うれしそうに手をふっています。{turtle:live peek}ウミガメさんは、ちょっぴりてれて、くびをひっこめると、にっこり、かおを出しました。「おかえりなさい」 とシギくん。{turtle:hearts}{sandpiper:hearts}[softly]それからウミガメさんは、くるりとむきをかえて、{turtle:go to sea by swim}とおくの海へ、およいでいきました。{sandpiper:live wave}またね。

de-DE.title: Die Schildkröte kommt heim
de-DE.text: [slowly] Langsam, ganz langsam kroch {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} die Meeresschildkröte den Strand hinauf. {sfx:shuffle} Flipp… flopp… flipp… {sandpiper:enter by run} {sandpiper:go to turtle by run} Der Strandläufer kam angerannt, um zu schauen. {sandpiper:face surprised} [curious] „Wer bist du denn? Dich hab ich hier noch nie gesehen!“ {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live talk} [warmly] „Ach, aber ich war schon einmal hier“, sagte die Schildkröte. „Vor langer, langer Zeit bin ich genau hier geschlüpft, eine klitzekleine Schildkröte im warmen Sand. {sandpiper:wobble} Dann bin ich ins Wasser gekrabbelt und davongeschwommen. Quer über das weite Meer… und wieder zurück.“ {turtle:glow 0.4} [in awe] „Meeresschildkröten kommen immer heim“, sagte sie, „an den Strand, an dem sie geschlüpft sind.“ {sandpiper:live peck} Der Strandläufer pickte am Boden herum, als könnte er genau die Stelle finden. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Der Seestern winkte vom Tümpel herüber, {starfish:live wave} ganz aufgeregt. {turtle:live peek} Die Schildkröte zog den Kopf ein, einen Moment lang schüchtern, und lugte dann lächelnd wieder heraus. „Willkommen zu Hause“, sagte der Strandläufer. {turtle:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Dann drehte sich die Schildkröte um {turtle:go to sea by swim} und schwamm davon, weit, weit weg. {sandpiper:live wave} Bis zum nächsten Mal.

fr-FR.title: Le retour de Tortue
fr-FR.text: [slowly] Tout doucement, tout doucement, {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tortue de mer remontait sur le sable. {sfx:shuffle} Flip… flop… flip… {sandpiper:enter by run} {sandpiper:go to turtle by run} Bécasseau est arrivé en courant pour voir. {sandpiper:face surprised} [curious] « Qui es-tu ? Je ne t’ai jamais vue ! » {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live talk} [warmly] « Ah, mais je suis déjà venue ici, a dit Tortue. Il y a très, très longtemps, je suis sortie de mon œuf juste ici, une toute petite tortue dans le sable chaud. {sandpiper:wobble} Puis j’ai rampé jusqu’à l’eau, et je suis partie à la nage. J’ai traversé toute la grande mer… et me revoilà. {turtle:glow 0.4} [in awe] Les tortues reviennent toujours chez elles, sur la plage où elles sont nées. » {sandpiper:live peck} Bécasseau a picoré par terre, comme s’il pouvait retrouver l’endroit exact. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Étoile de mer a fait coucou depuis la mare, {starfish:live wave} toute joyeuse. {turtle:live peek} Tortue a rentré la tête, un peu timide, puis elle l’a ressortie avec un sourire. « Bienvenue chez toi », a dit Bécasseau. {turtle:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Puis Tortue a fait demi-tour {turtle:go to sea by swim} et elle est repartie à la nage, loin, très loin. {sandpiper:live wave} À la prochaine fois.

it-IT.title: Tartaruga torna a casa
it-IT.text: [slowly] Piano piano, {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tartaruga marina è risalita strisciando sulla sabbia. {sfx:shuffle} Flip… flop… flip… {sandpiper:enter by run} {sandpiper:go to turtle by run} Piovanello è arrivato di corsa a vedere. {sandpiper:face surprised} [curious] «Chi sei? Non ti ho mai vista!» {turtle:face happy} {turtle:live talk} [warmly] «Ah, ma io qui ci sono già stata», ha detto Tartaruga. «Tanto, tanto tempo fa, sono uscita dall'uovo proprio qui: una tartarughina piccina piccina, nella sabbia calda.» {sandpiper:wobble} «Poi sono scesa fino all'acqua e sono andata via nuotando. Ho attraversato tutto il mare, grande grande… e sono tornata indietro.» {turtle:glow 0.4} [in awe] «Le tartarughe tornano sempre a casa», ha detto, «sulla spiaggia dove sono nate.» {sandpiper:live peck} Piovanello ha becchettato per terra, come se potesse trovare proprio quel punto preciso. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Stella marina salutava dalla pozza, {starfish:live wave} tutta emozionata. {turtle:live peek} Tartaruga ha ritirato la testa, timida per un attimo, poi ha fatto capolino con un sorriso. «Bentornata a casa», ha detto Piovanello. {turtle:hearts} {sandpiper:hearts} [softly] Poi Tartaruga si è girata {turtle:go to sea by swim} e se n'è andata a nuoto, lontano lontano. {sandpiper:live wave} Alla prossima!

zh-TW.title: 海龜回來了
zh-TW.text: [slowly]慢慢地，慢慢地，{turtle:enter}{turtle:go to sand}海龜從水邊爬上沙灘。{sfx:shuffle}啪嗒……啪嗒……啪嗒……{sandpiper:enter by run}{sandpiper:go to turtle by run}濱鷸跑過來看。{sandpiper:face surprised}[curious]「你是誰呀？我從來沒見過你！」 {turtle:face happy}{turtle:live talk}[warmly]「可是，我以前來過這裡喔，」 海龜說，「很久很久以前，我就是在這裡，從蛋裡孵出來的。那時候，我是一隻小小、小小的海龜寶寶，躺在暖暖的沙子裡。」 {sandpiper:wobble}「後來，我爬到水邊，游走了。游過好寬好寬的大海……又游回來了。」 {turtle:glow 0.4}[in awe]「海龜啊，總會回家，」 牠說，「回到自己出生的沙灘。」 {sandpiper:live peck}濱鷸在地上啄呀啄，好像想找到那個地方。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星在潮池裡揮手打招呼，{starfish:live wave}興奮得不得了。{turtle:live peek}海龜把頭縮進去，害羞了一下，然後又探出頭來，笑咪咪的。「歡迎回家。」 濱鷸說。{turtle:hearts}{sandpiper:hearts}[softly]然後，海龜轉過身，{turtle:go to sea by swim}游走了，游到好遠好遠的地方。{sandpiper:live wave}下次見喔。

zh-HK.title: 海龜回來了
zh-HK.text: [slowly]慢慢地，慢慢地，{turtle:enter}{turtle:go to sand}海龜沿着沙灘爬上來。{sfx:shuffle}啪噠……啪噠……啪……{sandpiper:enter by run}{sandpiper:go to turtle by run}濱鷸跑過來看看。{sandpiper:face surprised}[curious]「你係邊個呀？我未見過你喎！」 {turtle:face happy}{turtle:live talk}[warmly]海龜說：「我以前嚟過㗎。好耐好耐以前，我就喺呢度，喺暖暖嘅沙入面孵出嚟，好細好細㗎。」 {sandpiper:wobble}「之後，我爬落水，游咗出去。游過好闊好闊嘅大海……又游返嚟。」 {turtle:glow 0.4}[in awe]牠說：「我哋海龜呀，一定會返屋企，返到自己出世嗰個沙灘。」 {sandpiper:live peck}濱鷸低頭啄啄地面，好像想找出海龜出生的那個地方。{starfish:enter}{starfish:go to pool}海星在石池那邊揮手打招呼，{starfish:live wave}興奮得不得了。{turtle:live peek}海龜害羞地把頭縮進去，過了一會兒，又笑着探出頭來。濱鷸說：「歡迎你返嚟！」 {turtle:hearts}{sandpiper:hearts}[softly]然後，海龜轉過身，{turtle:go to sea by swim}游走了，游到很遠很遠的地方。{sandpiper:live wave}下次見。
